## 2BHook v1.2.4

```nexus-summary
Your colours are saved: hair and mesh colours, Model Tint, material tints and pod colours go in
the config and come back every launch, with a new Save Appearance button. Heap Overflow keeps
the game going when a memory heap fills up.
```

A small update to 1.2.3.1, for the same game builds: Steam build 26534214 and v1.02 unpacked with
Steamless.

### New
- **Saved colours:** mesh colours (hair and the rest), **Model Tint Color**, material tints and the pod's mesh colours are saved in the config, by model and mesh or material name. They're put back whenever that model appears: after a relaunch, an area load or a respawn. An edit also shows on copies of the model already on screen. Hidden meshes still reset every launch.
- **Save Appearance** (Visuals, next to Rainbow Hair): saves only the colours into the config the Config tab would save to, and leaves your other settings in that file as they are. Its tooltip names the file; `default.xml` is the one loaded at startup. The Config tab's **Save** saves the colours too, and shows `Save *` while there are colour edits it hasn't saved.
- **Reset** buttons for a mesh colour, Model Tint and a pod mesh colour: they put back the game's colour and forget the saved one. Unticking a material tint forgets it too.
- Rainbow Hair, Rainbow Pod, Hide Pod and first person work as before on top of the saved colours.
- **Heap Overflow** (Miscellaneous, off by default): when one of the game's memory heaps is full, what it can't fit goes to an extra heap instead of stopping the game with the out-of-memory box. Tick it if the game runs out of memory, for example after spawning a lot. Extra heaps are made 256 MB at a time, up to 4 GB in all; the menu shows how many there are, and the console names the heap that filled up. It works however 2BHook is loaded, unlike Heap Scale, which has to be in place before the game makes its heaps.

### Fixes
- **Material Tint:** a tint's slot is freed when its model unloads, and there are 64 slots, up from 32.

### Other
- The console keeps its last 4096 lines (up to 1 MB of text) in one buffer made at startup, instead of allocating memory for every line.
- The DLL's version is 1.2.4.

### Known issues
- Saving a config with an older version of 2BHook drops its saved colours.
- Heap Overflow's extra heaps stay allocated until the game closes.
- Chams and Glow colour an enemy's own model only. Weapons and parts drawn from a separate model keep their normal look.
- First person hides the head's shadow along with the head.
- Mods with hard-coded addresses for older builds can crash the game on build 26534214. For example, NASA needs its build 26534214 update.

### Install
- Put `2BHook.dll` in the game's `mods` folder with a proxy DLL loader or the 2B Mod Launcher (v1.5.1), or inject it at the main menu. See the README for details.
- Press **Insert** to open the menu.
